WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT tr.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) AS analysed_trade_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT trader_type, analysed_trade_count,
         CAST(analysed_trade_count AS REAL) / SUM(analysed_trade_count) OVER () AS share_of_total,
         AVG(analysed_trade_count) OVER () AS avg_count_across_types
  FROM type_counts
)
SELECT SUM(analysed_trade_count) AS combined_count,
       AVG(share_of_total) AS average_share,
       AVG(analysed_trade_count - avg_count_across_types) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM with_shares
WHERE analysed_trade_count > avg_count_across_types;
